variants.ingredient_information:
Composition: Chicken liver, animal fat (pork fat purified at 99.5%), tapioca starch, dried eggs, salmon (3%), potato protein, fish oil (salmon oil purified at 99.5%), hydrolysed animal proteins, minerals, hydrolysed yeasts 1% (of which free nucleotides 44%), pea fibre, xylo-oligosaccharides (0.4%), dried cranberry (0.02%).

Analytical constituents: Crude protein: 8.7%, crude fibre: 0.6%, crude fat: 6.7%, crude ash: 1.9%, moisture: 75%, calcium: 0.25%, phosphorus: 0.11%, sodium: 0.2%, magnesium: 0.01%, potassium: 0.11%, chlorides: 0.48%, sulphur: 0.02%, total taurine: 0.13%. Urine acidifying substance: DL-methionine. Metabolisable energy: 1,240 kcal/kg.

Additives: NUTRITIONAL ADDITIVES/kg: Vitamin D3 225 IU, Vitamin E (all-rac-alpha-tocopheryl acetate 3a700i) 50 mg, Selenium (sodium selenite 0.04 mg) 0.02 mg, Manganese (manganous sulphate monohydrate 13 mg) 4.3 mg, Zinc (zinc oxide 26 mg) 21 mg, Copper (copper (II) sulphate pentahydrate 6.7 mg) 1.7 mg, Iron (iron (II) sulphate monohydrate 21 mg) 7 mg, Iodine (calcium iodate anhydrous 1.8 mg) 0.9 mg, L-cystine 600 mg, DL-methionine technically pure 800 mg, L-carnitine 300 mg, taurine 200 mg.
